layouts.name: NAVAK Driving Academy GP
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped full course uses the complete north loop, inner return, long south straight and southeast outer hairpin; training cutoffs are excluded. Operator configuration photographs corroborate these major branch choices. Source bend detail remains provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3888.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
